queries.Central analytic strategy: Our approach: Predictive modeling of cognitive ability proxy measures from mental health, multimodal neuroimaging, polygenic scores, and environmental factors in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study, followed by commonality analysis of shared variance with mental health
queries.Data foundation: We will use data from t: Longitudinal multi-site Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study children baseline and two-year follow-up cognitive abilities mental health multimodal neuroimaging polygenic scores environmental factors predictive proxy measures commonality analysis
queries.Behavioral cognitive target: We will ope: confirmatory factor analysis modeling general cognitive ability as a latent g-factor from six behavioral cognitive task performance measures in children
queries.Mental-health outcome domain: Mental hea: child and adolescent mental health outcomes measured with Child Behavior Checklist emotional and behavioral problems and BIS BAS UPPS P temperament scales related to cognitive abilities
queries.Primary shared-variance inference: We wi: Commonality analysis of predicted cognitive ability proxy measures from mental health, multimodal neuroimaging, polygenic scores, and environmental factors in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study, using random-intercept linear mixed models to estimate shared variance across pairwise and comprehensive neurobiological and environmental predictors.
queries.Generalizability validation: We will imp: Nested leave-one-site-out cross-validation for predictive modeling of cognitive ability proxies from mental health, multimodal neuroimaging, polygenic scores, environmental factors in the ABCD study, with inner ten-fold cross-validation for hyperparameter tuning to assess generalizability across sites without data leakage.
queries.Mental-health proxy model: We will use P: Partial least squares prediction of cognitive abilities from Child Behaviour Checklist and temperament measures separately and combined in the ABCD Study to create mental health proxy measures for commonality analyses
queries.Neuroimaging proxy model: We will implem: Multimodal neuroimaging proxy measures of cognitive abilities using opportunistic stacking, Elastic Net set-specific prediction from task-fMRI, resting-state fMRI, structural MRI, and diffusion tensor imaging, and Random Forest combination of predictions to handle missing data in adolescent brain cognitive development.
queries.Genetic feature construction: We will ca: polygenic scores from large-scale genome-wide association studies of cognitive abilities used to predict cognitive performance and test genetic representation of the cognitive ability mental health relationship in children
queries.Genetic proxy model: We will use Elastic: Elastic Net prediction of cognitive abilities from three polygenic score definitions using threshold selection and genetic principal components to control population stratification in children
queries.Environmental feature space: we will inc: Predictive modeling of cognitive abilities from environmental features including socio-demographics, lifestyle, and developmental adverse events in children, and commonality analysis of environmental contributions to the cognitive ability mental health relationship in the ABCD study.
queries.Environmental proxy model: We will apply: Partial least squares prediction of childhood cognitive abilities from socio-demographic, lifestyle, and adverse developmental event features with missing value imputation in adolescent brain cognitive development cohorts
queries.Confounding and dependency controls: We: Controlling for sex, age, and medication by residualizing cognitive abilities and neuroimaging or polygenic proxy measures, and modeling family nested within site in random-intercept mixed-effects commonality analyses of child mental health
queries.Longitudinal stability: We will repeat a: Longitudinal stability of confirmatory factor analysis models for cognitive abilities and mental health in children, with consistent standardization and repeated analyses at baseline and two-year follow-up in ABCD neuroimaging, polygenic score, and environmental factor studies
queries.Model evaluation and interpretability: W: Evaluating predictive accuracy and interpretability of cognitive ability proxy models from mental health, neuroimaging, polygenic scores, and environmental features using Pearson correlation, R squared, MAE, RMSE, PLS loadings, Elastic Net coefficients, and SHAP values for Random Forest
